title: 51:19 two sons. Because Israel has lost the gospel and its power to guide, direct, and lead to salvation, God has sent two priesthood holders to assist and bless her. These two are the two witnesses spoken of in Rev. 11:3-12, who will testify in Jerusalem for three and a half years, who will be killed and left dead in the streets, and who then will be resurrected and lifted up to meet Jesus Christ when he returns to make his appearance to the Jews.
author: Tina M. Peterson
